summary: Deal and relationship management CRM for investment banks, private equity, and other financial firms (Intapp).
access_note: Customer-only: API access is enabled per user by the customer's admin or DealCloud Customer Success Manager inside a licensed tenant; no self-serve sandbox found.
blocker_note: Enterprise product; no public signup, API enabled only inside licensed customer tenants.

evidence.quote: DealCloud uses the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow to generate a bearer token, which is then used in the HTTP Authentication header for API requests.
If you do not see the Admin section, contact your organization's admin or DealCloud Customer Success Manager (CSM) for assistance.
Tokens expire after 900 seconds (15 minutes) and must be refreshed by repeating the flow.
DealCloud MCP uses OAuth to authenticate, letting AI assistants connect on behalf of an individual user.

notes: Customer-only gating is inferred from the docs referencing admin/CSM and the absence of any self-serve signup; no page explicitly states docs are customer-only. REST inferred from bearer-token HTTP API; MCP endpoint URL not shown, docs hub URL used.
